goal: Generate a teaching diagram that allows middle and high school students to grasp the main concept of photosynthesis in one minute, suitable for direct use as a presentation single page or textbook insert.

style.color_palette: Soft beige + academic blue + light gray
style.rendering: Clear vector-like illustration + sans-serif Chinese bold text, annotation line in uniform deep gray 1.5pt

header.main_title: How does photosynthesis run through the leaves
header.subtitle: From light to sugar, strung together in six steps.
header.audience: Junior and senior high school transition class

centerpiece.description: A cross-section of a leaf, with the upper half showing enlarged spongy mesophyll cells, a chloroplast prominently in the center, chloroplast inner and outer membranes, thylakoid stacks, and stroma regions marked in low-saturation blue-green blocks, with stomata illustrated with enlarged circles on the leaf's undersurface showing open and closed positions

steps.count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.
items: 01 Light Energy is Captured by Antenna Pigments and Transferred to Reaction Centers
02 Water is Photolyzed on the Thylakoid Side, Releasing Oxygen and Creating Proton Gradient
03 Electrons Along the Transfer Chain and ATP Synthase Convert ADP + Pi into ATP
04 NADP+ is Reduced to NADPH Entering the Matrix
05 In the substrate, the Calvin cycle fixes and reduces CO2 using ATP and NADPH
06 Triose sugars can be output as sucrose or further synthesized into starch
steps.step_block_style: Number on the left, a concluding sentence + small icon, icon being geometric symbols like leaves, small suns, small water droplets, etc.

annotations.style: Fine Line Lead + Numbered Small Tag Pointing from Outer Edge of Main Image to Corresponding Area, Avoiding Passage Through Chloroplast Center
annotations.rule: Annotation lines do not intersect and do not pass through the central main structure.

summary_line: Photosynthesis = Light reaction (on the membrane) + Carbon fixation (in the stroma), net result: using light energy as fuel to convert CO2 and water into sugar and release oxygen.

must_keep: The central main image is the only complex graphic, arranged in six steps surrounding or in two columns, with clear reading order 01-06.
Main colors in the color palette ≤ 3; provide Chinese explanations for chemical formulas and abbreviations upon first appearance
Unified Chinese font across the entire page
avoid: Chemical pathways fill more than seven subpoints in one step
Simultaneously mixed with two styles of hand-painted watercolor and engineering drawings
Insert Brands and Advertisements in Scientific Diagrams
